title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch 3-Post Wall Mount Iron Pipe | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom safety and support with an ADA compliant grab bar featuring a long 63-inch span and a 3-post mounting design for enhanced stability.

  • Pipeline collection styling: industrial pipe design that coordinates with transitional bathroom hardware
  • 3-post grab bar: includes a third center bracket to help ensure stability
  • ADA compliant: designed to meet accessibility-focused bathroom needs
  • Wall mount: keeps floor space clear while providing a secure handhold location
  • Powder coat protection: highly durable finish engineered for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specifications

  • Overall length: 63 in
  • Height: 3 in
  • Width/Projection: 3.58 in
  • Weight capacity: 250 lb
  • Product weight: 5 lb
  • Material: Iron Pipe
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available

_previous.title: Pipeline Extended 3 Post Grab Bar - 60 inch
_previous.description: Make your bathroom a safer and more accessible space with the extended length 3 post grab bar from the Allied Brass Pipeline Collection. Designed with the needs of seniors, people with disabilities, and caregivers in mind, this grab bar provides balance, security, and ease of use. The industrial look of the Pipeline collection adds a modern touch to any bathroom decor, while the lifetime materials ensure a clean, decorative finish that lasts for years. With superior materials that are free from corrosion and rust, this grab bar is a reliable and stylish addition to your bathroom. Trust Allied Brass to provide high-quality bathroom fittings that enhance your safety and comfort.
